facts.value: None, no gold medals on story missions

facts.value: None, no replay, no New Game Plus

facts.label: Free roam after story
facts.value: Yes, everything outside the story stays open

missables.detail: Meditate at all 18 spots. The Chapter 1 balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1.
missables.name: Positive Mental Attitude
missables.risk: The only trophy that can lock the platinum.
steps: After Down to Earth, check Jason's house in the morning and find Lucia in the kitchen when she mentions meditating
Follow her to the balcony and accept, then make a manual save right after and keep it until the trophy pops

missables.detail: A street race in Yago's strand, marked with an hourglass icon.
missables.name: Race Against Yago
missables.risk: Time-sensitive in Chapter 3; its strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Watch for the hourglass icon in Chapter 3, save first, then race as soon as it appears

notes: Everything else stays available after the credits, including the side-story finales and the 100% checklist.
The 100% checklist only appears after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, but work you do earlier still counts.
Do not chase every collectible in the game. The checklist asks for only part of most categories.
Some optional missions become unavailable during certain story sections, but there are more optional tasks than the 100 required, so missing a few will not block A Long Road.

sources: Roadmap figures and checklist numbers: KeenGamer, GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Platinum Roadmap, 19 Nov 2026; cross-checked with Output Lag, GTA 6 Trophy List, 19 Nov 2026. Both guides agree on the 200-hour estimate, the 4/10 difficulty, one playthrough, no online trophies, no mission replay, 15 manual saves and cheats disabling trophies.

stages.name: Stage 1, Play the story
steps: Play Chapters 1 to 5 with Jason and Lucia
Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1, right after Down to Earth
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter
Scan vehicles with WAiNK and study animals with binoculars as you go
Take optional missions as they appear, especially ones that open robberies, fishing and hunting
Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3

stages.name: Stage 2, Reach 100% completion
steps: Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the credits
Finish the robbery numbers first; they also pay for garages and gear
Work the collectible numbers in the 100% Completion tab
Finish the activity numbers: 42 shooting range golds, 42 drone trials, 300 stunts
Check the tab often and stop each category at its number

stages.name: Stage 3, Clean up the rest
steps: Finish the side-story finales: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret
Earn the partner, combat and miscellaneous trophies
Check the trophy list for anything still missing
Vice Got a Price! pops with the last one
